title: Bid-Profile Supports
body_html:
Bid-Profile Supports

The basic auction layer includes support predicates for bid profiles and strategy profiles, including nonnegativity, membership in a product set, and membership in a rectangular box.

It also identifies bid-profile boxes with closed intervals.

References

  • [EconCSLib PR #27, blueprint/src/content.tex, def:auction_basic_bid_support] EconCSLib pull request #27, https://github.com/gametheoryinlean/EconCSLib/pull/27. Migrated from the PR's old leanblueprint section into mdblueprint staged form.
